N.en: What is one thing you regret saying recently?
N.zh: 最近一次最想撤回的话是什么？

N.en: Imitate your best friend for 15 seconds.
N.zh: 模仿你最熟悉的人 15 秒。

N.en: What photo on your phone would you never delete?
N.zh: 你手机里最舍不得删的一张照片是什么？

N.en: Give a dramatic confession to the air for 15 seconds.
N.zh: 对着空气深情表白 15 秒。

N.en: What habit would you most like to change?
N.zh: 如果可以重来一次，你最想改掉哪个坏习惯？

N.en: Say "I am ready for fate" like a news anchor.
N.zh: 用播音腔念出“我已经准备好接受命运”。

N.en: When were you secretly jealous last time?
N.zh: 你最近一次偷偷羡慕别人是因为什么？

N.en: Compliment one player three times without repeating.
N.zh: 选一位玩家，夸他三句不能重复。

N.en: Which app would you delete first if forced?
N.zh: 如果今天必须删掉一个社交 App，你删哪个？

N.en: Spin three times and introduce yourself seriously.
N.zh: 闭眼原地转三圈，然后一本正经地介绍自己。

N.en: What misunderstanding about you annoys you most?
N.zh: 你最怕被别人误解成什么样的人？

N.en: Say "I am not nervous" in three different emotions.
N.zh: 把“我不紧张”用三种情绪说出来。

N.en: What tiny thing makes you angry fast?
N.zh: 哪件小事最容易瞬间惹怒你？

N.en: Act out your current mood as an animal.
N.zh: 把你现在的心情用一种动物表演出来。

N.en: What compliment do you secretly want to hear most?
N.zh: 你最想听到别人怎么夸你？

N.en: Record a 5-second fake product ad for yourself.
N.zh: 给自己录一段 5 秒钟的夸张广告词。

N.en: Which bad habit do your friends tolerate the most?
N.zh: 你觉得朋友最忍你哪一个坏习惯？

N.en: Pose like a fashion model and freeze for 10 seconds.
N.zh: 摆一个时尚杂志封面动作并保持 10 秒。

SR.en: Say one real thought you never told your friends.
SR.zh: 说一个你一直没敢告诉朋友的真实想法。

SR.en: Ask one player to name your biggest weakness.
SR.zh: 随机点名一位玩家，请他评价你最明显的缺点。

SR.en: Describe your last genuine crush moment.
SR.zh: 你最近一次心动大概发生在什么场景？

SR.en: Give one player an idol-style greeting for 10 seconds.
SR.zh: 选择一位玩家，对他做 10 秒偶像式打招呼。

SR.en: Reveal one thing you are pretending not to care about.
SR.zh: 说出一件你表面不在乎，其实很在意的事。

SR.en: Read your last selfie caption in a seductive voice.
SR.zh: 用最做作的语气念出一条自拍文案。

SR.en: Who in the room do you want to know better, and why?
SR.zh: 现场哪位玩家是你最想进一步了解的，为什么？

SR.en: Send a harmless but embarrassing emoji to someone in recent chat.
SR.zh: 给最近聊天列表里的一位朋友发一个尴尬但无害的表情。

SR.en: What kind of person can make you lose your composure fast?
SR.zh: 什么样的人最容易让你破防？

SR.en: Let the group assign you a dramatic title for the next round.
SR.zh: 让全场给你取一个夸张称号，并保持到下一局。

SR.en: If you had to confess to someone here, who would it be?
SR.zh: 如果现在必须在场内选一个人表白，你会选谁？

SR.en: Read the last message you sent today in a movie trailer voice.
SR.zh: 用电影预告片的语气念出你今天发的最后一条消息。

SSR.en: Admit one thing you pretend not to care about.
SSR.zh: 当场承认一件你一直装作不在意的事。

SSR.en: Pull another player into a cheesy two-person skit.
SSR.zh: 拉一位玩家一起完成双人土味台词表演。

SSR.en: Reveal one fact that would shock an ex.
SSR.zh: 说出一个如果被前任听到会很震惊的事实。

SSR.en: Let the group rename you for the next round.
SSR.zh: 让现场所有人一起给你取一个新昵称，并沿用到下一局。

SSR.en: Who here would be the most dangerous person to fall for?
SSR.zh: 现场谁是最危险、最容易让人上头的人？

SSR.en: Call someone and say one dramatic line chosen by the group.
SSR.zh: 给一位朋友打电话，并按全场指定的台词演 10 秒。

SSR.en: Name one person here you would absolutely not date, and explain why.
SSR.zh: 说出现场一位你绝对不会谈的人，并说明原因。

SSR.en: Post a silly status chosen by the group and keep it for 3 minutes.
SSR.zh: 发一条由全场决定的搞笑状态，并保留 3 分钟。

SSR.en: What is your most embarrassing attempt to impress someone?
SSR.zh: 你为了吸引别人注意做过最尴尬的事是什么？

SSR.en: Reenact your most dramatic breakup or rejection scene.
SSR.zh: 表演一次你人生中最戏剧化的拒绝或分手现场。

UR.en: You are safe. Choose another player to answer instead.
UR.zh: 你免罚，但要指定一位玩家替你回答一道题。

UR.en: You may rewrite the next question into a harder version.
UR.zh: 本轮你拥有改题权，可以把题目升级成更刺激的版本。

UR.en: Pick any player and downgrade or upgrade their next punishment by one star.
UR.zh: 你可以指定任意一位玩家，让他的下一题星级上调或下调一星。

UR.en: Skip your own punishment and force the group to vote for a substitute player.
UR.zh: 你直接跳过本轮惩罚，并要求全场投票选出替代者。

UR.en: Choose one player to reveal two cards next round and take the worse outcome.
UR.zh: 指定一位玩家下轮必须翻两张卡，并接受更糟的结果。

UR.en: Declare one temporary safe player and one temporary danger player for the next round.
UR.zh: 你可以指定下一轮的一位安全玩家和一位高危玩家。
